units.source_text: 前来招徕顾客的客栈掌柜，穿上一身严严实实的冬装，包住两只耳朵，登着长统胶靴，活像火场上的消防队员。

en.t: The innkeeper who had come to call in customers was bundled tightly in winter clothes, with both ears covered and tall rubber boots on, looking just like a firefighter at the scene of a fire.

units.source_text: 一个女子站在候车室窗旁，眺望着路轨那边，她披着蓝色斗篷，蒙上了头巾。

en.t: A woman stood beside the waiting room window, gazing across the tracks; she wore a blue cloak and had a hood over her head.
